titled.name: Titled
titled.tagline: Save web pages as PDFs with titles you can recognize later.
titled.description: Preview a web page, create a PDF, and keep its filename and internal title in sync. Titled includes a searchable library and a Safari share extension.

features.title: Meaningful names
features.body: Extract page titles and keep PDF filenames and internal titles aligned, including after renaming.

features.title: Review before saving
features.body: Check the page preview before creating a PDF; some sites limit printing or need a login.

features.title: Saved library
features.body: Search, sort, read, rename, and delete PDFs stored locally or in your iCloud documents.

features.title: Share extension
features.body: Create a PDF from a web URL shared through the system share sheet.

privacy_sections.heading: Documents and settings
privacy_sections.body: Titled converts web pages on your device. PDFs remain in the app's local storage, shared App Group storage, or your own iCloud document storage. Settings and reading positions are stored on your device. iCloud storage and synchronization are provided by Apple under your Apple account.

privacy_sections.heading: Website connections
privacy_sections.body: Loading a page connects directly to that website and its resources. The website may receive your IP address, use cookies, or require a login. Its privacy policy applies. Titled does not bypass website access restrictions. Deleting a PDF does not delete website cookies.

privacy_sections.heading: Sharing
privacy_sections.body: You choose which PDF to share and where. Generated PDFs include the source web address in their metadata; the address may contain query parameters and travels with exported copies. Review it before sharing.

privacy_sections.heading: Analytics and advertising
privacy_sections.body: Titled contains no advertising or analytics SDKs. The developer does not operate a content-upload service for PDF conversion.

privacy_sections.heading: Contact
privacy_sections.body: For privacy questions, email atomsprout@gmail.com. This policy was updated September 22, 2026.

jsoncompare.name: JSON Compare
jsoncompare.tagline: A simple, native JSON diff tool for macOS.
jsoncompare.description: Paste two JSON documents into the panes and compare a deterministic, sorted representation side by side. Everything runs locally in a native SwiftUI app, so private payloads never leave your Mac.

features.title: Side-by-side diff
features.body: Added and removed lines stay aligned in two readable panes.

features.title: Order-insensitive
features.body: Object keys are sorted before comparison so key order does not create noise.

features.title: Format & validate
features.body: JSON is parsed and pretty-printed, with clear errors for invalid input.

features.title: Keyboard friendly
features.body: Compare, edit, clear, and navigate with native controls and shortcuts.

features.title: Native performance
features.body: Built in SwiftUI. Opens instantly, idles cheaply.

features.title: No cloud
features.body: Your payloads never leave the app. No telemetry.

privacy_sections.heading: Introduction
privacy_sections.body: JSON Compare respects your privacy. This document describes what data, if any, the app collects and how it is used.

privacy_sections.heading: Information we collect
list: Anonymous usage data and crash reports.

privacy_sections.heading: How we use information
list: To keep the app working and fix bugs.
To respond to questions you send to us directly.

privacy_sections.heading: Data security
privacy_sections.body: Where data is transmitted off-device, it is sent over TLS and not shared with third parties for marketing.

privacy_sections.heading: Data retention
privacy_sections.body: We keep only what is needed to provide the service. You can request deletion at any time.

notbadbookmark.name: NotbadBookmark
notbadbookmark.tagline: A modern replacement for Chrome's default bookmark manager.
notbadbookmark.description: If you save a lot of links, the built-in manager is painful. NotbadBookmark is a clean, fast extension with real search, drag-and-drop folders, and light and dark themes. It uses Chrome's own bookmark store, so your existing bookmarks and browser sync remain available.

features.title: Real search
features.body: Live filtering across titles and URLs, instant results.

features.title: Folder DnD
features.body: Drag bookmarks into folders, drag folders into folders.

features.title: Chrome bookmarks
features.body: Manage your existing bookmarks without migrating to a separate service.

features.title: Keyboard navigation
features.body: Arrow keys, enter, escape — get around without a mouse.

features.title: Light + dark
features.body: Follows your system theme.

features.title: No new account
features.body: Sits on top of Chrome's own bookmark store. Sync still works.

voicedraft.name: VoiceDraft
voicedraft.tagline: Turn a recording into something you can edit and share.
voicedraft.description: Record an idea or import audio, then choose an editable action: summarize it, research the topic with sources, prepare to act, or use your own prompt. Every result is an editable Markdown document.

features.title: Record or import
features.body: Keep the source audio and a timestamped transcript so you can return to what you said.

features.title: Editable actions
features.body: Choose from three built-in prompts or create your own. Each action produces one Markdown draft you can preview and edit.

features.title: Apple-first processing
features.body: Use on-device speech recognition and generation; eligible longer tasks may use Apple Private Cloud Compute.

features.title: Optional providers
features.body: Configure an external model provider yourself. Sending original audio requires separate destination-specific consent.

features.title: Copy or share
features.body: Copy the Markdown or share a .md file. Keep the original recording and transcript for reference.

privacy_sections.heading: Recordings and local data
privacy_sections.body: Recordings and exported Markdown files are kept in your VoiceDraft folder in iCloud Drive when available, or locally on your device when iCloud Drive is unavailable. Transcripts, generated outputs, settings, and prompts are stored locally. iCloud Drive sync is provided by Apple under your Apple Account; the developer cannot read your iCloud Drive.

privacy_sections.heading: Apple processing
privacy_sections.body: Default speech transcription runs on device. Short generation uses Apple’s on-device model. Eligible longer or more complex generation may use Apple Private Cloud Compute. Availability and processing by Apple follow its applicable terms.

privacy_sections.heading: Optional external providers
privacy_sections.body: External generation and audio transcription are separate choices and are off by default. Generation can send transcripts, timestamped source segments, and selected prompt instructions to the provider you configure. Original audio is sent only after destination-specific consent. The Research action sends the transcript and selected prompt, but not the audio, to a configured web-search provider after a separate confirmation. Provider retention and account practices are governed by that provider.

privacy_sections.heading: Keys, sharing, and deletion
privacy_sections.body: External-provider keys are stored in Apple Keychain. You choose when to share exported files. You can delete recordings, outputs, keys, and local app data in Settings; exported copies and provider-held copies must be managed separately.

privacy_sections.heading: Analytics and contact
privacy_sections.body: VoiceDraft has no advertising or analytics SDK and does not operate a server for your content. If you email support, we receive the information you choose to send so we can reply. Contact atomsprout@gmail.com. Updated September 30, 2026.

launchdeck.name: LaunchDeck
launchdeck.tagline: Apps, files, and actions at your fingertips.
launchdeck.description: A keyboard-first macOS launcher for apps, files, and reusable workflows. Optional on-device intent search uses Apple Intelligence on supported hardware. Distributed through Homebrew and GitHub Releases.

features.title: Instant launch
features.body: Open any installed application with a global shortcut and a few keystrokes.

features.title: Fuzzy search
features.body: Match by name, category, or aliases — typos and abbreviations are fine.

features.title: Optional intent search
features.body: Describe what you want to do. Requires Apple Intelligence-capable hardware and an available on-device model.

features.title: Keyboard-first
features.body: Built for power users. The mouse is optional, end to end.

features.title: Categories & ordering
features.body: Group apps the way you think about them, not how the Finder sorts them.

features.title: Native and lightweight
features.body: A small Swift app. No Electron, no background bloat.
